change: Cache raw paint/raster surfaces only within conservative transformed content bounds, retaining integer offsets and the existing 64MiB/64-entry budget.
scope: Production Chromium, 800x600, 5/64 layers; observational performance, exact browser pixel checks separately.
limitations: 64-layer operations still have main-thread tasks over 50ms.
Final styled surfaces and other layer types retain existing full-region caching.
Bounds are conservative; empty or offscreen content may use a one-pixel transparent cache surface.
